footer.rules: Rules text is SRD 5.1 or a summary in our own words for D&D 5e (2014). When in doubt, check the book. Saved in this browser only; back up your sheet as text under “Setup”.
footer.srd: This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1 (“SRD 5.1”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC and available at https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document. The SRD 5.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License available at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode. SRD data via the 5e-bits/5e-database project (MIT). German texts are our own translation.

hp.title: Hit Points
hp.amountLabel: Amount for damage, healing or temporary HP
hd.title: Hit Dice
hd.left: {a} of {b} left · {d} {m} each on a short rest
death.title: Death Saves
death.hint: d20 at the start of your turn: 10+ is a success. A 1 counts twice, a 20 restores 1 HP.
cond.title: Conditions
exh.title: Exhaustion · Level {n}
atk.title: Attacks
atk.none: No weapon in hand. Drag a weapon to the main or off hand in the inventory.
atk.note: To hit = ability modifier + proficiency bonus if proficient. Tap to switch between proficient and not.
quick.title: Quick Use
res.title: Class Abilities
res.channelC: Turn Undead or your domain effect
res.luck: Turn a miss into a hit
res.arcanum: One high-level spell each, no slot
res.recovery: On a short rest, regain slots up to total level {n}
res.relentless: At 0 HP drop to 1 HP instead
feat.title: Features
spell.title: Spells
spell.none: No spells yet. Add some in the Wiki or under “Setup”.
spell.pactHint: Slots at level {n} · back after a short rest
spell.castNote: “Cast” asks for the level when several slots are free, and sets concentration if needed.
skill.title: Skills
conc.title: Concentration
conc.hint: On damage: CON save, DC 10 or half the damage.
eq.head: Head
slot.head: Head
inv.help: Hover to see properties. Drag to move, equip or stack. On a phone: tap, then tap a free cell.
inv.ownSummary: Create your own item (e.g. from the DM)
inv.ownText: What does it do? (rules, damage, effect)
common.name: Name
wiki.pick: Choose an entry on the left.
wiki.asiLevels: Feat or ability increase at level {a}. Subclass features at level {b}.
wiki.nothingMine: Nothing matching is on your sheet yet.
wiki.nothingAll: If something from the book is missing, add it as your own entry.
wiki.search: Search: Fireball, healing, Grappled, Rage, Elf …
setup.intro: Enter your character here. You play on the Sheet and manage items in the Inventory.
setup.raceBonus: Racial bonus: {b}. If not done yet, add it to the ability scores below (imported characters already include it).
setup.hintLevel: Get new levels with “Level Up” above. HP, proficiency, spell slots, abilities and features are filled in automatically.
setup.hintStart: Choose class and ability scores, then “Build Level 1” above. For a higher start, level up several times afterwards.
setup.skillHint: Tap to cycle: not proficient, proficient, Expertise.
setup.featsEmpty: These arrive with level-ups. Add your own feats or subclass features here.
setup.resEmpty: These arrive with level-ups, e.g. Rage, Bardic Inspiration, Second Wind.
setup.pactHint: Pact magic (Warlock) returns after a short rest.
setup.backupHint: Everything lives only in this browser, so save a backup file regularly. A single sheet can still be exported as text.
setup.importConfirm: Replaces the current character. Click again.
lu.subPick: You choose your subclass ({subs}). Its features are in the book; add them under “Setup”.
lu.subFeature: At level {n} you get a subclass feature. Look it up and add the text under “Setup”.
lu.firstHint: Enter CON under “Setup” first, it counts here. {s} saving throws will be marked as proficient.
lu.featPh: Name of the feat, e.g. War Caster
lu.asiNote: Maximum 20. Feats are in the Player’s Handbook, chapter 6.
lu.spellNote: Find new spells afterwards in the Wiki (filter “Spells” and your class) and add them with one click.
lu.errRoll: Please enter the rolled value or take the average.
lu.errFeat: Please enter the name of the feat.
lu.featText: Feat. Look up its effect and add it here.
lu.doneFeats: Level {n} reached: +{g} HP, new features are on the sheet.
toast.saveFailed: Saving failed. Is the portrait too large? Choose a smaller image.
toast.raceBonus: Racial bonus: {b}. Please add it to your ability scores.
toast.deadAt0: Damage at 0 HP at least equal to max HP: instant death.
toast.failAt0: Damage at 0 HP: one death save failure (two on a critical hit).
toast.massive: Remaining damage at least equal to max HP: instant death by the rules.
toast.short: Short rest: “short rest” abilities are back. To spend hit dice, mark the boxes and enter the result under “Heal”.
toast.shortPact: Short rest: “short rest” abilities and pact magic are back. To spend hit dice, mark the boxes and enter the result under “Heal”.
toast.long: Long rest: HP full, spell slots and abilities back, up to {n} hit dice back.
toast.exhDown: Exhaustion lowered by 1 (only with food and drink).
toast.condStay: {s} stays active: conditions do not end with a rest, but when their cause ends.
toast.noSlot: No free slot of level {n} or higher.
toast.ritualHint: As a ritual it works without a slot (10 minutes longer).
toast.occupied: Occupied: {a} cannot go on “{s}”. Put it elsewhere first.
toast.twoHanded: Note: {a} is two-handed, but the off hand is occupied.
toast.badExport: That is not a valid export. Please paste the complete text.
toast.badExport2: That is not a valid export.
toast.unknownFormat: Format not recognized. Expected an export from this sheet.
toast.badImage: The image could not be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
toast.tempNoStack: Temporary HP do not stack. The higher value stays.
toast.stable: Three successes: stable. Unconscious, but no more saves needed.
toast.noSlotFit: No fitting equipment slot. Set the slot in the selection box.
toast.maxAttune: At most three attuned items. End another attunement first.
toast.copied: Copied. Paste it under “Setup” on the other device.
toast.selected: Text is selected. Copy with Ctrl+C (Mac: Cmd+C).
toast.needImport: Paste the export text or load a file first.
footer.icons: Icons: Shikashi's Fantasy Icons Pack by Matt Firth (shikashipx, cheekyinkling), CC BY 4.0, based in part on designs from game-icons.net, CC BY 3.0.
chars.title: Characters
lu.mcNote: Multiclassing: you need the ability scores of this class and of every class you already have. No extra saving throws and only some proficiencies.
dm.enable: Show DM area on this device
dm.empty: No one in the fight yet. Add monsters or characters below.
dm.hint: Enter each initiative from your table rolls. Tap a name for conditions, notes and the stat block. Defeated monsters are skipped.
dm.notePh: Write freely. Link other notes with [[Name]].
dm.noteNone: Choose a note or create a new one.
dm.backupHint: DM data lives only on this device, separate from the characters.
live.title: Live Table
live.error: No connection. The online service may be paused.
live.shared: While connected, your name, class, level, HP, AC, conditions, exhaustion, concentration and death saves go to everyone with this code. The DM can suggest damage, healing and conditions; your sheet only changes when you accept. Your sheet works without a connection too and always stays saved on this device as well.
live.dmIntro: Open a room and give the code to your players. They enter it under “Setup” and you see their HP and conditions live.
live.dmBusy: This device is currently in a room as a player. Opening a room leaves it.
live.added: Players added to combat. Their HP stays up to date.
imp.hint: Backups from the other character tool (“dnd-backup”) are added as new characters. Your own exports replace the current one.
imp.invalid: This file does not match the expected format (field: {p}).
imp.ownItems: Items not in the catalog (kept as your own entries)
imp.inNotes: Could not be mapped, moved to Notes
imp.asiNote: Ability score increases from levels were not applied; please check.
setup.acUnknown: The equipped armor has no known values. Enter the AC by hand, or turn off the automatic calculation.
sheet.hint: PDF or image of a character sheet works too; you check the values before anything is created.
sheet.ocr: Reading the image. The first time this takes up to a minute …
sheet.reviewHint: Reading a sheet is never perfect. Correct anything that is wrong, then create the character.
sheet.nothing: No character sheet could be recognized in this file.
sheet.failed: The file could not be read.
sheet.ocrLoad: Reading images needs an internet connection the first time.
insp.title: Inspiration
insp.on: You have Inspiration. Click when you use it.
insp.off: No Inspiration. Click when the DM grants it.
chg.title: Charges
chg.dawnHint: Roll at the table and enter how many charges return. Empty fields stay unchanged.
pet.title: Companions
pet.bm: Beast Master rules: proficiency bonus to AC and attacks, HP at least 4 × ranger level
bg.oldKept: Skills of the old background were removed; tools, languages, gear and gold stay.
bg.dupSkills: You already had {n} of these skills; the PHB lets you pick others instead.
setup.stylesHint: Archery, Dueling, Two-Weapon Fighting and Defense are included in your numbers.
dm.cheatSearch: Search rules: falling, cover, travel pace ...
live.hoEmpty: Please add a title, text or image.
live.hoBadImage: That image could not be used.
bak.hint: The file holds all characters and DM data, and also works for moving to another device.
bak.nagHint: The last one is over a week old. Characters live only in this browser.
bak.confirm: Load the state from {d} with {n} characters? This replaces everything in this browser. The current state is kept in the earlier versions first.
bak.bad: That is not a valid backup file.
loot.title: Loot
loot.coinHint: Roll d100 at the table, enter it, then roll the coins.
loot.sendHint: The item goes to the chosen recipient, who has to accept it.
loot.offline: To hand out loot, open a room under Live table first.
inv.figPick: Choose an image for the figure
inv.locked: The DM hands out loot. Items and coins arrive as suggestions you accept.
loot.lockHint: While players are connected they cannot add items themselves. This is an agreement, not a protection.
dm.placeEmpty: No monsters at this place yet.
cloud.title: Saved online
cloud.ready: Connected, saving on the next change.
cloud.conflict: There is a newer online version of this sheet, for example from another device. Nothing is overwritten automatically.
cloud.setup: Not set up yet: the SQL script (supabase/charbogen-saves.sql) is missing in the Supabase project.
cloud.error: Saving failed, for example without internet. I will try again on the next save.
cloud.empty: Nothing saved in this room yet.
cloud.note: Saving happens automatically while you are in the room: players save their active sheet, the DM saves the DM area. Anyone with the room code can see and load them.
cloud.loadedNew: Character added from the room. You find it under Characters.
cloud.loaded: Online version stored. You find it under Characters.
cloud.loadedDm: DM area loaded from the room.
live.dmReopenHint: On a new device: enter your previous room code to find the DM area and the group sheets saved online.
fx.title: In effect now
fx.sight: Checks that rely on sight fail automatically
fx.hear: Checks that rely on hearing fail automatically
fx.crit: Hits from within 5 ft are critical
fx.note: Worked out from conditions, exhaustion and armor. If in doubt, the rule text applies.
dm.turnsHint: Players in the live room see whose turn it is (monsters with challenge rating) and can end their own turn.
skill.reliable: For skills you are proficient in, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as 10.
bright.label: Brightness
res.stone: Reaction when damaged: reduce by {d} + CON modifier
mon.enOnly: Monster stat blocks are English only (SRD 5.1).
mode.label: View
mini.label: Quick view
dmm.title: Dungeon Master
dmm.intro: This device runs in DM mode: no own character, with its own tabs for combat, encounters, loot, places and notes, live table and cheat sheet.
dmm.hint: Turning it off brings back sheet, inventory and notes. Saved characters are kept.
live.levelHint: Sends every connected player a level-up to accept.
xp.title: Experience points (XP)
xp.hint: When you reach the threshold you can level up. Your DM decides when.
xp.noneDefeated: No monster defeated yet. Monsters at 0 HP count automatically, but you can also enter the total yourself.
xp.sendNote: Every connected player gets their share as a proposal to accept.
xp.offline: No live room open: read the share aloud, everyone enters it under Setup.
xp.offlineToast: No live room: {n} XP each, please read it aloud.
dm.hereNoPlaces: Create a place, then you can mark it as the current place.
dm.noSession: No session note yet. Create one at the start of each game night.
skin.label: Look
lu.pick.book: New spells for your spellbook: {a} of {b} chosen
lu.pickNote: Only spells of your class that you can cast at the new level are listed. Once the number is reached the rest are locked; you can always deselect. Choosing fewer is fine, you can add the rest later in the wiki.
res.sub.flare: Reaction: attack against you has disadvantage (Wis mod per long rest)
res.sub.wrath: Reaction when hit: 2d8 lightning/thunder (Wis mod per long rest)
res.sub.warPriest: Bonus action weapon attack after Attack (Wis mod per long rest)
res.sub.undying: At 0 HP drop to 1 HP instead
res.sub.natural: On a short rest regain slots up to total level {n}
res.sub.misty: Reaction when damaged: invisible, teleport 60 ft
res.sub.delirium: Creature in an illusory realm (1 minute)
res.sub.luck: +1d10 to an ability check or save
res.sub.portent: Foretelling d20s after a long rest
